detail: Rashi Peripherals Limited received a formal disclosure filing from Krishna Kumar Choudhary under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, as mandated for any person acquiring 5% or more of voting rights or triggering control thresholds.
